title: THE STARTUP
THAT ALMOST DIED
scenes.narration: This is a test of every room the engine can draw.

scenes.label: DORM ROOM
scenes.narration: Two students in a dorm room, with one laptop and a big idea.

scenes.label: GARAGE
scenes.narration: Then a garage, three people, no salary.
Users doubled every year, and the office filled up.

scenes.label: DEAL ROOM
scenes.narration: Then a one point two billion dollar valuation, and a crash the next year.
The company was on fire, and not in a good way.

scenes.label: LAB
scenes.narration: The last three built one new feature.

scenes.label: SERVER ROOM
scenes.narration: And the servers could barely keep up.

scenes.label: APP STORE
scenes.caption: TRY IT FREE
scenes.narration: Today you can try it for free. Link in the description.
